title: Elementary symmetric polynomials and a potentially injective family of maps on partitions
summary: In this article, we provide an infinite family of examples to disprove a recent conjecture due to Ballantine and her collaborators on the injectivity of a class of maps, namely pre_k, defined on integer partitions. These maps arise from applying the sequence of elementary symmetric polynomials to integer partitions, where pre_k is associated with the kth polynomial. Subsequently, we state a modified version of their conjecture.
